_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Israel covering Canaanite period, Israelite kingdoms (David, Solomon), Babylonian exile, Second Temple period, Roman province (Judea), Jewish revolts, Byzantine Palestine, Arab conquest, Crusader states, Mamluk/Ottoman Palestine, Zionism, British Mandate, 1948 Declaration of Independence, Arab-Israeli wars, Six-Day War 1967, Yom Kippur War 1973, Camp David Accords, Oslo Accords, intifadas, settlements, and ongoing Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

ethnic_groups.name: Jewish Israeli
ethnic_groups.notes: Diverse origins: Ashkenazi (European/US ~44% of Jews), Mizrahi/Sephardi (Middle East/North Africa ~44%), Ethiopian (Beta Israel ~2%), mixed; Hebrew-speaking; Law of Return

ethnic_groups.name: Arab Israeli (Palestinian citizens)
ethnic_groups.notes: Arabic-speaking; mostly Muslim, also Christian and Druze; remained after 1948; citizens with voting rights; identity tension; Bedouin sub-group in Negev (~280,000)

ethnic_groups.name: Druze
ethnic_groups.notes: Galilee and Golan Heights; distinct monotheistic faith; serve in IDF; loyal to state; ~148,000

ethnic_groups.name: Circassian
ethnic_groups.notes: Two villages (Kfar Kama, Rehaniya); Sunni Muslim; serve in IDF; arrived Ottoman era

ethnic_groups.name: Other (foreign workers, asylum seekers)
ethnic_groups.notes: Thai, Filipino, Chinese workers; Eritrean/Sudanese asylum seekers (~25,000); Russian non-Jewish immigrants

independence.notes: Declaration by David Ben-Gurion; immediately followed by 1948 Arab-Israeli War

country_profile.notes_unique: Only Jewish-majority state; nuclear-armed (undeclared); 'Start-Up Nation'; Iron Dome missile defence; Dead Sea lowest point on Earth; kibbutz movement; ongoing occupation of West Bank (since 1967)
special_status_languages: Arabic (formerly official, now 'special status' since 2018 Nation-State Law)

geography.terrain: Coastal plain; central highlands; Jordan Rift Valley; Negev desert (60% of land area)
geography.notes: Dead Sea (-431m) lowest point on Earth's surface; Negev desert 60% of territory; Sea of Galilee critical freshwater source; diverse climate zones in small area; occupied territories disputed.

economy_extended.notes: 'Start-up Nation' — highest VC per capita globally; tech sector 18% GDP; natural gas discoveries (Leviathan, Tamar); diamond cutting/trading hub; OECD member; defense industry major exporter; economic impact of Oct 7 war significant.

health.notes: Universal healthcare (1995 National Health Insurance Law); world leader in medical research; highest life expectancy in Middle East (83 years); world's fastest COVID vaccine rollout; Magen David Adom emergency services.

food_agriculture.notes: World leader in agricultural technology (drip irrigation invented by Netafim); 'made the desert bloom'; highest crop yields per hectare in many categories; agri-tech exports global; kibbutz farming tradition.

energy.notes: Leviathan and Tamar gas fields transformed from energy importer to exporter; gas exports to Egypt and Jordan; 30% renewable target by 2030; Dimona nuclear facility (undeclared nuclear arsenal); Negev solar potential.

transport.notes: Ben Gurion Airport major hub; high-speed rail Jerusalem-Tel Aviv (A1 train); light rail systems in Jerusalem and Tel Aviv (Red Line 2023); compact country — most destinations within 1-2 hours; security-intensive aviation.

tourism.notes: Religious tourism (Christianity, Judaism, Islam); Dead Sea lowest point on Earth; Tel Aviv 'White City' (Bauhaus, UNESCO); Oct 7 war severely impacted 2024 tourism; tech tourism/conferences; Birthright programme.

legal_system.notes: No formal constitution (Basic Laws serve as quasi-constitution); 2023 judicial overhaul crisis (massive protests); Coalition politics (proportional representation); military court system for occupied territories; ICJ ruling on occupation (2024).

human_rights_gender.lgbtq_legal_status: Legal (no marriage but recognition of foreign marriages; military service open)
human_rights_gender.notes: Strong democracy for citizens within Green Line; West Bank/Gaza occupation human rights concerns (B'Tselem, HRW, ICJ); conscription includes women; LGBTQ+ most progressive in Middle East; settler violence; Oct 7 aftermath civil liberties debate.

security_stability.notes: Oct 7, 2023 Hamas attack (1,200 killed, 250 hostages); Gaza war ongoing; nuclear weapons state (undeclared, est. 80-400 warheads); Iron Dome missile defense; Hezbollah threat (north); Iran existential threat; multi-front security posture.

cultural_heritage.notes: Only country to revive a dead language (Hebrew); kibbutz movement unique; Holy Land significance for Judaism, Christianity, Islam; Israeli tech culture ('chutzpah'); Dead Sea Scrolls; diverse immigrant cultures.

comparative_rankings.notes: Start-up Nation — highest VC per capita; top happiness despite conflict; high HDI; tech innovation powerhouse; security situation drags peace rankings; Nasdaq-listed companies (most outside US).
comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.
